checks.name: Signed stock/covered-call expiry cost, value and PnL are hand-computed
Long put, short stock and nonstandard option contract multiplier
Pre-expiry BSM portfolio Greeks use quantity sign and multiplier
Per-leg IV scenarios distinguish 10% relative (22%) and absolute (30%)
Different expiries and expired leg explanation use scenario intrinsic
Injection works for type-specific American Greeks without hidden BSM fallback
American model integration, cash dividend timing aliases and price-only parity
European cash-dividend price and Greeks match European-exercise escrowed lattice
Scenario curve shares one baseline and returns identical prices to individual scenarios
Marks value without replacing model Greeks, and expiry ignores marks
Import sorts dates, accepts safe numeric strings and uses dated quote chain
Import rejects duplicate/invalid records, crossed quotes, bad OHLC, HTML and numeric expressions
Historical volatility of known log returns matches sample and population formula
History ordering, symbol selection, adjusted closes and insufficient window validation
Input validation rejects unsupported legs, mixed underlying and unsafe values
Browser globals expose valuation without CommonJS and extreme price ratios stay finite

sourceBasis: Archived OIC Profit and Loss Simulator guide: quantity scaling, contract size, relative/absolute IV scenarios, BSM/CRR style distinction
Archived OIC Historical and Implied Volatility guide: annualized historical volatility
limitations: Single underlying per valuation; cash flows, transaction costs and historical settlement omitted
Cash-dividend European/American legs use per-leg escrowed approximation; residual-stock diffusion varies with leg expiry, not one globally consistent dividend process
Imported quotes and imported contract IV only; no live feed or proprietary IVX
HV uses consecutive available observations, not reconstructed missing trading dates; return window and sample/population divisor explicit
Expiry gamma/theta are undefined; ATM expiry delta is undefined; aggregate affected Greeks return null
